import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.base import ClassifierMixin
from factory.operators.base import Operator, OperatorMeta
from factory.schemas import OperatorKind

class LightGBMClassifier(ClassifierMixin, Operator):
    meta = OperatorMeta(
        name="LightGBMClassifier",
        kind=OperatorKind.MODEL,
        version=1,
        origin="synthesized",
        description="利用梯度提升树进行多分类，支持类别权重平衡优化，适用于文本向量化后的特征输入。",
        conditions=["输入为数值特征矩阵或稀疏矩阵", "支持类别不平衡"],
        dependencies=["lightgbm", "numpy", "pandas", "scikit-learn"],
        params={
            "num_leaves": 31,
            "learning_rate": 0.05,
            "n_estimators": 500,
            "class_weight": "balanced"
        }
    )

    def __init__(self, num_leaves=31, learning_rate=0.05, n_estimators=500, class_weight="balanced"):
        self.num_leaves = num_leaves
        self.learning_rate = learning_rate
        self.n_estimators = n_estimators
        self.class_weight = class_weight

    def _ensure_numeric(self, X):
        """处理输入数据，兼容 DataFrame 和稀疏矩阵，并处理缺失值/无穷值"""
        if isinstance(X, pd.DataFrame):
            # 移除所有非数值列，将非数值转为 numeric，无效值转为 NaN
            X = X.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
            # 填补缺失值和无穷值
            X = X.fillna(0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0)
        return X

    def fit(self, X, y):
        # 训练阶段处理输入
        X_train = self._ensure_numeric(X)
        
        # 实例化 LightGBM 模型
        self.model_ = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
            num_leaves=self.num_leaves,
            learning_rate=self.learning_rate,
            n_estimators=self.n_estimators,
            class_weight=self.class_weight,
            importance_type='gain',
            verbose=-1
        )
        
        self.model_.fit(X_train, y)
        self.classes_ = self.model_.classes_
        return self

    def predict(self, X):
        # 预测时复制以保持接口规范
        X_test = self._ensure_numeric(X.copy())
        
        # LightGBM 原生支持稀疏矩阵和缺失值，直接预测
        return self.model_.predict(X_test)

    def predict_proba(self, X):
        # 预测时复制以保持接口规范
        X_test = self._ensure_numeric(X.copy())
        
        # 返回 shape (n, n_classes) 的 numpy 数组
        return self.model_.predict_proba(X_test)

lessons.title: 样本不平衡导致默认模型召回率偏低
lessons.trigger: 流失场景存在正负样本不平衡，模型默认阈值或未配置样本权重时召回率达不到业务要求
lessons.fix: 启用平衡类权重（如 class_weight='balanced' 或 BalancedLightGBMClassifier）以提升召回率

lessons.title: LightGBM 调参及不平衡处理
lessons.trigger: 数据量在 5k 到 10w 之间，或者样本不平衡时
lessons.fix: 设置 num_leaves 15~63, learning_rate 0.03~0.1, n_estimators 200~600；不平衡时设置 class_weight='balanced'；树模型无需标准化。

lessons.title: 数值列含空白字符导致类型转换失败
lessons.trigger: 新入网客户累计消费为空白字符串，读取为 object 类型，转 float 时抛出 ValueError: could not convert string to float: ' '
lessons.fix: 先 str.strip()，再 pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')，缺失值填补为 0

lessons.title: 未剔除客户 ID 导致 One-Hot 编码后维度暴涨与内存溢出
lessons.trigger: customer_id 等标识列未剔除，直接进行 One-Hot 编码导致特征维度暴涨并引发内存溢出
lessons.fix: 建模前剔除 ID 等标识列，并在编码器中设置最大类别数

lessons.title: 随机森林防过拟合与召回优化
lessons.trigger: 使用随机森林模型，面临过拟合风险，或业务要求召回优先时
lessons.fix: 设置 n_estimators 300 左右，限制 max_depth 在 8~16 防止过拟合；召回优先时需配合调整分类阈值。
